qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact three-byte, one-instruction memory SETNE at the measured fixture RIP. The same decoded operation at an adjacent RIP declines.
admission.transactionality: The shared measured-memory SETcc emitter materializes pending flags, computes the effective address and condition result, and performs the byte store only as the block's final transactional write.
admission.deferred: All other memory SETNE forms remain interpreter-owned; the independently qualified measured memory SETE site remains admitted under its own exact boundary.

verification.focusedGate: The measured memory SETE and SETNE tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,450 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Both zero-flag outcomes match the interpreter exactly in architectural state and destination memory.
verification.negativeCoverage: The identical bytes at the adjacent RIP decline; the existing shared-emitter regression retains failed-write rollback coverage.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed and decline differences are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.
